text:
Kent Johnson is the biggest breakout on our board. The fifth overall pick in 2021 is playing 17:45 a night, up from 13:14, and is on the ice for 80% of Columbus's power-play time after 37% last season. The result: 16 points in 16 games, after 0.29 points a game a year ago, and 12th of 515 skaters in wins added by goals. He's also the league's shootout artist, which The New York Times and The Hockey News both wrote up.

The chances have improved, from 0.69 expected goals per 60 to 1.03. That part is real.

The finishing isn't, at least not at this rate: 8 goals on 4.9 expected, shooting 24% after 6% last season. Our range for him sits around 10 to 15%. And the five-on-five picture is ordinary, with Columbus getting 49% of the expected goals with him on. Evolving-Hockey had his team creating little with him on the ice last season (bottom 6% of forwards), so the bigger role is a test he's passing so far on the scoresheet. Watch the five-on-five chances once the shooting cools.
headline: Kent Johnson finally got the minutes
